sample.description: Validation sample from public sources for descriptive claims: World Bank WDI annual NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS (trade/GDP), NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.CD (PPP GDP), TX.VAL.FUEL.ZS.UN (fuel export share) for CAN/USA/EUU/EMU/WLD 2015-2023, plus IMF DOTS via DBnomics annual bilateral exports CA->U2 (Euro Area), CA->W00 (World), CA->US 2015-2024; counts/parameters taken from paper Section 2 methodology. Full benchmark BVAR monthly sample (5 CA +4 US +4 EA variables, oil/trade/financial extensions, JK median rotation shocks, 3 lags, linear trend, COVID dummy) uses Fortin 2022 Large Canadian Database + IMF-IFS CAD/EUR + FRED/Fed + Eurostat sts_inpr_m + BAMLHE00EHYIOAS not fully rebuildable from public vintage.

not_rebuilt.claim_oil_GDP: Oil ~10% of Canadian GDP requires Statistics Canada GDP by industry (value added of oil & gas extraction + support + petroleum and coal product manufacturing) from StatCan table 36-10-0402 and NRCan input-output; public WDI oil/mineral rents (NY.GDP.PETR.RT.ZS ~0.03-2.8%, NY.GDP.MINR.RT.ZS unavailable) are accounting rents, not value-added share, insufficient to replicate 10% figure without StatCan vintage.

sample.substitutions: WDI aggregate EUU (European Union, 27 members) used as proxy for Euro Area (EA19/EMU) trade/GDP where WDI EA code not available; EMU PPP share reported alongside (12.2% vs 14.7% EUU, paper 15% roughly between). IMF DOTS Euro Area counterpart U2 (changing composition) used for Canada export share to Euro Area; WDI fuel export share TX.VAL.FUEL.ZS.UN used as proxy for oil export share (20-25%): fuel includes oil+gas, closest public series. Standard FRED/WB annual frequencies (2015-2024) substitute for paper's monthly VAR sample (1999-2023). No market_data (yfinance) series needed; WDI/DBnomics public APIs accessed with standard User-Agent. Parameter values quoted from paper Section 2.2 and Dieppe et al 2016 BEAR manual.

notes: Choices paper leaves open and deviations: (1) Euro Area trade/GDP & PPP share aggregates: paper figure likely Euro Area 19; WDI provides EUU (EU27) and EMU (EA19) – we report both: EMU trade not in WDI NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS (only EUU/XC), PPP EMU 12.2% vs EUU 14.7%; we present EUU as closest. (2) Export share denominator: IMF DOTS W00 (World excluding IO) vs paper potentially Statistics Canada merchandise totals; DOTS U2/W00 yields ~4% share validating <8% (US ~76%). Calendar uses annual DOTS (consistent FOB) vs paper DOTS quarterly. (3) Oil GDP 10% not computable: WDI rents understate value-added; would need StatCan industry GDP. Fuel share proxy slightly broader than oil alone. (4) Risk-free/benchmark calendar alignment, exact sample window (start/end not stated) and shock vintage (JK shocks median rotation until 2019 vs updates until 2023Jun): we use 2015-2024 validation window. (5) IRF persistence durations (over year, 18 months, 4 months, etc.) require Bayesian VAR + Local Projections with sign-restriction rotation (999 angles) and credible intervals; replication omits them due to proprietary Fortin vintage and estimation complexity/time. (6) Standard hyperparameters (lambda1 0.1, lambda3 1, prior mean 0.8) from Dieppe et al BEAR prior. COVID dummy Mar2020-Jun2021 included in benchmark, Feb2020 truncation for robustness. SEs for means = sd/sqrt(n); SE 0 for observed extrema (min/max). Counts/params have se null/n null per spec. No email placed in script; SEC EDGAR not needed. | Trade/GDP EA: EUU WB NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS 2015-2023 mean 90.68% min 83.8% all >80% (WDI EU aggregates include EUU). Paper figure aggregates Euro Area trade >80%; EUU is closest WDI aggregate available (EMU similar). Trade/GDP US: WB NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS 2015-2023 mean 26.13% (paper states ~25%). Trade/GDP CA: WB 2015-2023 range 61.2-67.0% mean 65.1% (paper 60-70%). SE 0 for extrema (observed min/max). GDP PPP share EA: WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.CD EUU/WLD 2019-2023 mean 14.96% (EMU mean 12.30%); paper ~15% for Euro Area (EUU vs EMU distinction). Export share to Euro Area: IMF DOTS A.CA.TXG_FOB_USD U2/W00 2015-2024 mean 4.15% max 4.89% (<8% as claimed); US share mean 76.1% (paper notes US dominance). Fuel export share: WDI TX.VAL.FUEL.ZS.UN (fuel = proxy for oil; WDI oil-only series discontinued) 2015-2023 mean 22.6% range 17.6-30.2% (paper 20-25% for oil; fuel slightly broader). Counts/params verified from paper Section 2.1-2.2: 5 Canadian +4+4 foreign variables, 7 export categories, 5 GDP components; VAR 3 lags (AIC 4 BIC 2), LP 3 lags, Normal-Wishart prior mean 0.8 lambda1 0.1 lambda3 1, COVID dummy 202003-202106 (paper: March 2020-June 2021), exclusion sample ends 202002 (paper: February 2020), 90% credible/confidence bands, 999 rotations.
